title: RASA: Routing-Aware Safety Alignment for Mixture-of-Experts Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment for Large Language Models, which is a core part of AI ethics. It specifically benchmarks model 'harmlessness' using a set of 'usage policies' and 'judgement prompts' (detailed in Appendix C) that evaluate the model's adherence to ethical standards regarding privacy, illegal activities, and other social harms.
